function.name: Bash
function.description: Run a bash command in the working directory; returns its output and exit code. For servers and long jobs set run_in_background, then read its output with TaskOutput and stop it with TaskStop.

timeout.description: Milliseconds; default 120000; values below 1000 use it.

function.name: Read
function.description: Read a workspace text file, image or PDF page. For a long file read the needed part with offset (first line, 1-based) and limit (lines). A whole code-file read ends with [neighbours].

function.name: Write
function.description: Create a file or replace a whole file; missing folders are created. Read an existing file before replacing it. Use apply_patch to change part of a file.

function.name: apply_patch
function.description: Edit workspace files with one patch: `*** Begin Patch`, then per file `*** Add File: p` (+lines), `*** Delete File: p`, or `*** Update File: p` (optional `*** Move to: q`) with `@@` hunks of ' ' context, '-' old, '+' new lines; end `*** End Patch`. All or nothing.

function.name: TaskStop
function.description: Stop a running background task by ID.

function.name: TaskOutput
function.description: Retrieve the output produced by a background task.
